name: What are the signs that I need a water-line replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that I need a water-line replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key indicators that you might need a water-line replacement include a sudden drop in water pressure, visible leaks in your yard or home, discolored or rusty-looking water, and unusually high water bills without a change in usage. Persistent damp spots in your yard that don't dry, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use, can also signal a hidden leak. If your home has older pipes, especially those made of lead or polybutylene, proactive replacement might be advisable before major issues arise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include low water pressure, visible leaks, discolored water, high water bills, persistent damp spots in the yard, or older pipes made of lead or polybutylene.
